remarks: Charming Cottage on 1920's Estate: Welcome to this beautifully updated North Stamford Guest Cottage, tucked away on a private driveway and offering privacy, natural light and an inviting living space with a wall of windows in the Living room area. A Washer and Dryer are conveniently located in the full bathroom. The long paved driveway offers ample parking for two and perfectly complements the character of the Cottage. Located just minutes from New Canaan, Pound Ridge NY and downtown Stamford, with easy access to major highways and train stations, this cozy home combines convenience with peaceful, private surroundings. Updates in process: Fresh paint throughout, new kitchen countertops, walk-in closet, refreshed and move-in ready by the 4th! It's the perfect blend of charm, convenience and modern comfort. Left garage bay with automatic opener, 2nd parking spot behind the left bay. Sorry, No pets.
